walls.note: Front of the monument from the south-east (artifacts/landmark-refs/vondelmonument/pano-b.jpg); bronze poet, three seated allegories, inscription panel, chain posts.

items.where: bronze Vondel seated in a high-backed chair, cloak over the shoulders, forearm on a book on the knee
items.how: figure kit (figure-kit.ts) seated on a carved chair with turned legs: writing, pen in the right hand at the chest, left hand on a book on the knee, long hair and the cloak behind; 3.3 m standing-height kit figure; no facial modelling

items.where: four seated winged allegories on the base step at the die corners: front left with the tragic mask, front right with the lyre, rear right with a book, rear left praying
items.how: four kit figures (3.0 m standing height) in sandstone with long robes, folded wings behind and the lyre, mask and book as hand props; drapery folds are not modelled

items.where: pale sandstone pedestal: stepped base, die, moulded cap and dark bronze plinth, about 4.7 m high
items.how: builder: stacked boxes at panorama-measured proportions

items.where: inscription panel and carved relief panels on the die
items.how: raised gold stroke lettering on the front die: JOOST VAN DEN VONDEL and GEVESTIGD TE AMSTERDAM; the remaining lines of the text and the three city arms are not legible enough and are left out

items.where: ring of eight carved sandstone posts with gabled caps joined by chains, round the monument
items.how: builder: eight box posts with cone caps and thin dark chain bars on an octagonal kerb; carved ornament omitted
